tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Jul 27 est., -7bp from Jul 17's 145bp as the US-Iran strike pause and Omani diplomatic talks eased risk sentiment) but remains well above the Jun 22-23 compression zone. The relief tightening is fragile — the pause could collapse at any time, and the Hormuz blockade remains in effect with tanker transits near zero. Maintain protection at 60-70%; do not reduce on the tactical tightening. Stress (35%): iTraxx returns to 150-180bp on pause collapse. Tail (45%): spikes to 200-230bp if strikes resume at scale. Only reduce on a confirmed blockade lift.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF €63.58/MWh (Jul 24, Trading Economics, +2.71%) while JKM $22.00/MMBtu (Jul 24, +0.80%) — the JKM-TTF spread has widened further as Europe aggressively outbids Asia for disrupted Gulf LNG cargoes. Qatar's extended force majeure into Aug-Sept (JOGMEC) and 13 nights of US strikes on Iran deepen the supply squeeze. The long-JKM/short-TTF thesis that relied on Asia's supply-lag premium is now dead. Close any remaining position. Both markers face continued upside risk on the Hormuz blockade; the relative-value edge is gone.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

tradeIdeas.title: Close ASEAN Banks Long / Hold Energy Underweight - Compression Trade Invalidated
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Jul 27 est., -7bp from Jul 17's 145bp) — the tactical relief on the strike pause partially reversed the compression breakdown but the structural thesis (risk-on compression supporting banks) remains invalidated by the underlying crisis. ASEAN Banks ~206 idx est. (-1.0% from Jul 18's 208) still green zscore but lacking credit-spread tailwind. ASEAN Energy ~118 idx est. (+2.6% tracking Brent at $91.91) remains deeply depressed vs baseline (zscore -3.40) — the war-zone discount still dominates. Hold the energy underweight; close the banks long only when credit spreads show sustained compression.
instruments: ASEAN Banks ETF (hold neutral, no long)

tradeIdeas.title: Maintain Long USD/PHP and USD/IDR - Pause Is Tactical, Not Structural
tradeIdeas.rationale: USD/PHP ~55.65 est. (Jul 27, -0.4% from Jul 17's 55.85) and USD/IDR ~15,750 est. (-0.6% from 15,850) edged lower as the strike pause prompted tactical EM FX relief. The relief should not be used to reverse positions — the Hormuz blockade remains in effect, tanker transits are near zero, and the diplomatic pause is fragile with no confirmed breakthrough. Brent $91.91 remains well above the Jun 30 $73.62 entry level, keeping energy import bills structurally elevated. Maintain short PHP/IDR (long USD) positions; re-enter long PHP/IDR only on a confirmed Hormuz reopening or MOU restoration.
instruments: ASEAN EM FX basket (maintain short vs USD)
